sentence: The take-up of AI by key account managers is shaped by their personality traits, and organizational culture moderates the agreeableness path
passage: [Mehta et al. (2025), p. 543] "Our research shows that key account managers' adoption of AI technologies is influenced significantly by personality traits." / "Organisational culture significantly moderates the association between agreeableness and the adoption of AI technologies."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly confirms both that personality traits influence AI adoption and that organizational culture moderates the effect of agreeableness, directly supporting the sentence.
